title: Spain's Lamine Yamal warns France: 'we have no fear' ahead of World Cup semifinal
summary: The 2026 Football World Cup is in its final stretch. Tomorrow, England will take on Argentina for a place in the finals. And this evening, France will play Spain in their semifinals match. French coach Didier Deschamps predicted a “spectacular” match, while Spanish star Lamine Yamal shared a warning to Les Bleus. Our sports reporter Selina Sykes is covering…
